title: Buyer Beware
text: Buyer Beware. Ordered these for a wedding.  Flowers and vase were pretty and arrived in a timely manner.  Lights don't work.  I don't have time or capacity to determine if it's just a battery issue or product defect.  This is a quality control issue that rendered this product useless for me.

product_metadata.title: Artificial LED Pink Rose Flowers with Glass Vase, Flower Arrangement for Table Centerpiece, Home Office Wedding Decoration
features: PACKAGE - Including LED lights, 3 aritficial Rose Bouquets and a Glass Vase. Total height is about 13”/33CM. Vase height is 6.3"/16CM. Flower height is about 13”/33CM.
CREATIVE LED DECORATION - This Table LED flowers is perfect for your wedding, party, baby shower or home decor, etc.
EASY TO SET UP- Put half of the led lights in the vase, and wrap the rest around the fake flowers. AA batteries not included.

LIGHT UP YOUR LIFE - The entire flowers and vase are decorated with LED light, you can use it to decor any place you want. The flowers look natural and lifelike, let your life full of nature breath,the LED light can decorate your home and relieve your work pressure.
UNIQUE AND GREAT GIFT - The warm white light illuminates the flowers and vase, and even the surrounding things. Warm white light not only benefits our eyes, but also gives us a romantic atmosphere.
description: -Exquisite Appearance The artificial rose flowers are made of real silk, making it the same as real one and giving you a true touch. The stem is made of plastic with steel inside. You can bend or cut it whatever you like to fit in your vase. -Unique Design The entire flowers and vase are decorated with LED light, which gives a romantic atmosphere. -Glorious Moral The rose flowers stands for wealth and passion. You can buy it for your parents, friends and lovers as gifts. It is also ideal for decorating you home, table, office and parties to add vitality. -Easy to Clean The artificial rose is dirt-proof. If there is little dirt on the flowers, you can just use dry cloth to wipe it. It can also be washed with water, then dry it with clean cloth.
